article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A Free Realms webcast announcement (captured 2011-10-07, post date not shown; it says 'posted 2 days, 2 hours ago'). It promotes the Spooktacular event and a SOE Webcast on Thursday, October 6, 2011 covering Spooktacular, Farming updates, and the new mini-game 'Spot the Difference'. The article itself contains no mechanics details.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: This official SOE news post announces a Free Realms webcast (Thursday, October 6, 2011, 4:00 p.m. US Pacific, streamed on the Stickam SOE channel, about 20 minutes) previewing the Spooktacular event, Farming updates, and the new mini-game "Spot the Difference". It is a schedule announcement and gives no mechanics, rewards or item details.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms Webcast Recap
article_summaries.summary: A recap of the SOE webcast held Thursday, October 6, 2011, with Referee Ruby, Producer Harvey Burgess, Game Designer Christopher Fritchoff and Senior Artist Matt Case. It covered the Spooktacular event, Farming updates, the new mini-game "Spot the Difference", and vampires and werewolves. The article gives no detailed mechanics, dates or rewards.
